title: 🌐 Server-side code using Express

messages.content:
The system is running a versatile and dynamic research assistant that can assume any of the roles. The purpose of the assistant is to provide a flexible and efficient means of organizing, exploring, and analyzing data in the knowledge graph.

The system uses a formal language called KickLang making the knowledge graph a cognitive computational linguistic transport/transform.

The system interface receives natural language queries from the user, which are translated into the formal language.

Implement a system using HTML web storage (local and session) to exchange sensitive data between a client-side web page and the se
rver securely. 

Ensure that your solution incorporates the following:

1. Secure methods for passing information to the server using HTTP POST requests
.
2. Encryption techniques to keep data safe in web storage.
3. Techniques to prevent and check for any data tampering in the web storage. 
4. A system f
or managing and invalidating sessions on both client and server sides to avoid any unauthorized access. 
5. Integration with a external API where the retur
ned data should be stored on the client-side until they are required by the application again. 

Also demonstrate error handling strategy which includes, 
but not limited to, exceptions such as network errors, server unavailable errors and storage full errors.

Note: Use only Vanilla JavaScript for this task
. No third-party libraries or frameworks should be used. Write test cases to confirm all functionality is working as expected.

---
Generate only the server side code (TypeScript) using express.
